cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.15)

# Shader Compilation Configuration
set(SHADER_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
set(SHADER_OUTPUT_DIR ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/shaders)

# Create shader output directory
file(MAKE_DIRECTORY ${SHADER_OUTPUT_DIR})

# Vulkan shader compiler (glslc) configuration
find_program(GLSLC glslc HINTS ${VULKAN_SDK}/bin)
if(NOT GLSLC)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "glslc shader compiler not found!")
endif()

# Define shader sources
set(SHADERS
    lob_heatmap.comp
    tpo_profile.comp
    footprint_vert.glsl
    footprint_frag.glsl
)

# Shader compilation target
add_custom_target(compile_shaders ALL
    COMMENT "Compiling Vulkan shaders"
    VERBATIM
)

# Compile each shader to SPIR-V
foreach(SHADER ${SHADERS})
    get_filename_component(SHADER_NAME ${SHADER} NAME)
    get_filename_component(SHADER_EXT ${SHADER} LAST_EXT)
    string(TOLOWER ${SHADER_EXT} SHADER_EXT_LOWER)
    
    # Determine shader stage based on filename or extension
    set(STAGE "")
    if(SHADER MATCHES ".*_vert\\.")
        set(STAGE vertex)
    elseif(SHADER MATCHES ".*_frag\\.")
        set(STAGE fragment)
    elseif(SHADER MATCHES ".*_comp\\.")
        set(STAGE compute)
    elseif(SHADER MATCHES ".*_geom\\.")
        set(STAGE geometry)
    elseif(SHADER MATCHES ".*_tesc\\.")
        set(STAGE tessellation_control)
    elseif(SHADER MATCHES ".*_tese\\.")
        set(STAGE tessellation_evaluation)
    elseif(SHADER_EXT_LOWER STREQUAL ".vert")
        set(STAGE vertex)
    elseif(SHADER_EXT_LOWER STREQUAL ".frag")
        set(STAGE fragment)
    elseif(SHADER_EXT_LOWER STREQUAL ".comp")
        set(STAGE compute)
    elseif(SHADER_EXT_LOWER STREQUAL ".geom")
        set(STAGE geometry)
    elseif(SHADER_EXT_LOWER STREQUAL ".tesc")
        set(STAGE tessellation_control)
    elseif(SHADER_EXT_LOWER STREQUAL ".tese")
        set(STAGE tessellation_evaluation)
    else()
        message(WARNING "Unknown shader type for: ${SHADER}")
        continue()
    endif()
    
    set(INPUT_SHADER ${SHADER_DIR}/${SHADER})
    set(OUTPUT_SPIRV ${SHADER_OUTPUT_DIR}/${SHADER_NAME}.spv)
    
    # Add compilation command
    add_custom_command(TARGET compile_shaders
        COMMAND ${GLSLC} -fshader-stage=${STAGE} ${INPUT_SHADER} -o ${OUTPUT_SPIRV}
        DEPENDS ${INPUT_SHADER}
        COMMENT "Compiling ${STAGE} shader: ${SHADER}"
        VERBATIM
    )
    
    # Install shaders to output directory
    install(FILES ${OUTPUT_SPIRV}
        DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_DATADIR}/shaders
    )
    
    # Add shader to sources list for IDE integration
    set_source_files_properties(${INPUT_SHADER} PROPERTIES
        HEADER_FILE_ONLY TRUE
        COMPILE_DEFINITIONS "SHADER_PATH=\"${OUTPUT_SPIRV}\""
    )
endforeach()

# Add shaders to IDE project
source_group("Shaders" FILES ${SHADERS})

# Optional: Install shader source files for debugging
install(FILES ${SHADERS}
    DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_DATADIR}/shaders/sources
    COMPONENT shader_sources
)

# Optional: Generate shader include file for C++
set(SHADER_INCLUDE_FILE ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/ShaderPaths.h)
file(WRITE ${SHADER_INCLUDE_FILE}
    "/**
 * @file ShaderPaths.h
 * @brief Auto-generated shader path definitions
 * @generated by CMake
 */

#pragma once

namespace shaders {
"
)

foreach(SHADER ${SHADERS})
    get_filename_component(SHADER_NAME ${SHADER} NAME)
    string(TOUPPER ${SHADER_NAME} SHADER_MACRO)
    string(REPLACE "." "_" SHADER_MACRO ${SHADER_MACRO})
    
    file(APPEND ${SHADER_INCLUDE_FILE}
        "    const char* ${SHADER_MACRO} = \"${SHADER_OUTPUT_DIR}/${SHADER_NAME}.spv\";\n"
    )
endforeach()

file(APPEND ${SHADER_INCLUDE_FILE} "}\n")

# Install generated include file
install(FILES ${SHADER_INCLUDE_FILE}
    DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR}/btq_render_engine
)
